title: Australian Inland Mission Hospital, Birdsville

terrainReference.basis: Original field at the main hospital's Adelaide Street-facing approach.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named hospital footprint and Queensland Heritage Register 602635
mapIdentity.scope: Four native outline ways wholly on protected Queensland Heritage Register parcel 602635, for the named Australian Inland Mission Hospital and three outbuildings.

note: Queensland’s register describes the 1953 single-storey prefabricated steel hospital, low corrugated gabled hip, broad enclosed verandahs, covered access and separate former ward.
